notes: הִקְטִיר headed on 'incense' as the complement carrying the lexeme (rule 44); heading on 'burnt' as the lexical verb was the competing reading.
תֹעֲבוֹת הַגּוֹיִם is rule 29's arthrous case: the article takes the 'the' before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one, nothing fronted.
